declaration.preface: Advanced Supply Chain Group Limited (ASCG), a Reconomy Group company, is committed to protecting and promoting the fundamental rights of all employees, workers, and partners. ASCG has developed this Labour & Human Rights Roadmap to outline structured actions, measurable goals, and governance mechanisms that ensure the organisation fosters ethical labour practices across all global operations. This document should be read in conjunction with Reconomy Group RGPOL_005_modern_slavery.
declaration.declaration:
ASCG is committed to achieving the following general human rights objectives:

Promote a safe, healthy, and inclusive workplace.

Ensure fair wages, working hours, and conditions.

Prohibit child labour, forced labour, and modern slavery.

Prevent all forms of discrimination and harassment.

Support freedom of association and collective dialogue.

Provide opportunities for employee development.

Respect the rights of external stakeholders affected by our operations.
declaration.scope:
This roadmap applies to all activities undertaken by ASCG, suppliers and partners and aligns with the overarching policies and standards of Reconomy Group.

The roadmap covers all ASCG operational, administrative, and strategic activities across the following sites and regions:

focusAreas: Child Labour, Forced Labour, and Trafficking Prevention

Health and Safety of Employees: Maintain a 0% recordable workplace injury rate by Year 2028 through the implementation of proactive safety training and risk mitigation strategies.
Working Conditions and Fair Pay: Conduct annual pay equity reviews within banded areas of the business.
Conduct employee satisfaction surveys on working conditions every year.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI): Publish an annual Gender Pay Gap Report starting 2024, with transparent reporting and improvement actions.
Social Dialogue and Employee Engagement: Maintain the “Employee Voice Forum” across all sites by 2028, providing a safe and inclusive platform for employees to raise concerns and contribute to workplace improvements.
Training and Career Development: Ensure 100% of new hires complete induction training within their first 30 days.
Discrimination and Harassment: Maintain a zero-tolerance policy with all reported cases investigated within 5 working days.

responsibilities.duty: Approve the policy, allocate resources, and review labour and human-rights performance.
Implement fair employment practices, maintain grievance channels, and track workforce commitments.
Maintain safe working conditions, address hazards, and ensure worker training and participation.
Apply human-rights due diligence to suppliers, contractors, and service providers.
Treat colleagues with dignity, report concerns without retaliation, and uphold this policy.

policy.monitoring:
Should modern slavery, forced labour or human rights breaches be detected within the business and supply chain, there should be an appropriate escalation process. We would refer to the police and seek advice (in the UK) from the NCO Unseen helpline 0800 0121 700 and report via the Unseen modern slavery website.

The roadmap is available on ASCG’s intranet and external communications portal.

All employees and contractors will receive onboarding and refresher briefings.

Awareness campaigns and training modules will be promoted quarterly.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The roadmap will be reviewed annually by the Managing Director or sooner if triggered by:

Legislative or regulatory changes

Grievances, incidents, or internal audits

Reconomy Group strategy updates

The review process ensures that ASCG continues to uphold high standards in labour and human rights.
